title: Mad Soul
wikitext:
__NOTOC__{{NPC infobox | image = See the [[#Gallery|gallery]] for a selection of images | campaign = Nightfall | level = 20 | type = Ghost }} [[Mad Soul]]s are found throughout the locations in the [[Realm of Torment]], driven mad by their long captivity and their proximity to the mad god [[Abaddon]]. ==Locations== *[[Realm of Torment]] **{{NPC location|Gate of Fear}} **{{NPC location|Gate of Madness|outpost}} **{{NPC location|Gate of Pain|outpost}} **{{NPC location|Gate of Secrets}} **{{NPC location|Gate of Torment}} **{{NPC location|Gate of the Nightfallen Lands}} **{{NPC location|Nightfallen Jahai}} **{{NPC location|The Shadow Nexus|outpost}} ==Dialogue== After the [[Ruins of Morah]] mission, they respond with one of the following lines: :''"A fountain of youth. It was a fountain of youth, and now I will be young forever...."'' :''"It is not hands that summon them. It is desire..."'' :''"It's you! Turai! Save me, [[Turai Ossa]]! You've come for me at last!"'' :''"Oh gods, the pain! My daughter... eaten alive. How I wish it had been me. She was lucky! :''"There is a song at the center of the world, my friend, and it sounds like razors through flesh."''
After completion of the [[Nightfall campaign]]: {{spoiler|the Nightfall storyline}} :''"A new god is born! A god that will destroy the others and bring about the end of the world! The cycle begins again!"'' :''"Burn? Such a limited imagination."'' :''"Hold to life too tightly, and you'll choke away its breath."'' :''"[[Kormir]]. How brave you were to join us in the Realm of Torment. How mad you were to choose to never leave."'' :''"When you walk dark paths, you open your mind to nightmare. Poor Kormir, poor sad goddess raised up to the stars, cursed to see only infinite blackness between them...."'' ==Gallery== File:Tormented Soul m.png Image:Tormented Soul f.jpg Image:Ascalonian ghost f.jpg File:Telius.jpg File:Ghost Necromancer.jpg File:Ascalon Guard m ghost.jpg ==Trivia== *Several quotes paraphrase similar lines from [[w:Pinhead (Hellraiser)|Pinhead]] in the [[w:Hellraiser (film series)|Hellraiser series]] ([http://www.imdb.com/character/ch0008734/quotes source]).
